title: When the Weather Wakes
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Theo Joubert, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
